review_scope.correlation: Same agent team/model workflow; source/premise/control review only.

actual_contract_review.domain: An arbitrary typed Quiver V and a fixed root r. TotalEdge V is Sigma source, Sigma target, source -> target, retaining actual arrow values and endpoint tags. Existing Quiver.PathStar r is reused, not replaced by a new path structure.
actual_contract_review.encoding: taggedPrefunctor maps every source object to the existing SingleObj TotalEdge and every actual arrow to its source/target/arrow triple. encodePath composes actual mapPath with the previously checked chronological SingleObj edgeOccurrences. encode extends it to existing PathStar r.
actual_contract_review.validity: ValidFrom r [] is True; ValidFrom r (edge::rest) requires edge.source=r and ValidFrom edge.target rest. finish follows all targets and keeps r on empty input; finish alone is not a validity check or invalid-list decoder.
actual_contract_review.injectivity: tagged_star_injective proves injection on each entire outgoing star including varying targets. encode_injective explicitly invokes upstream Prefunctor.pathStar_injective, then existing SingleObj edge-list injectivity. It does not replace star injectivity by a weaker per-Hom condition or use covering surjectivity.
actual_contract_review.actual_construction: decode r edges hvalid recursively constructs edge.toPath.comp suffix, transporting the actual first-source equality. encode_decode and decode_encode are proved on actual data; decode_endpoint identifies the typed endpoint with finish. pathStarEquivTrace is exactly PathStar r equivalent to the ValidFrom r subtype.
actual_contract_review.append: Actual path composition encodes as chronological list append. finish_append and validFrom_append_iff retain the required boundary: second starts at finish r first. No adjacency condition is inferred from list concatenation alone.
actual_contract_review.assumptions: No thinness/Hom-subsingleton, finite graph, acyclicity, DecidableEq V or inhabited alphabet assumption. The decoder is indexed by a validity proof; an executable JSON decoder is not supplied.
actual_contract_review.root_boundary: Root is fixed by the equivalence parameter. A root-free empty edge list cannot distinguish nil paths at different vertices. No equivalence with all arbitrary tagged lists is stated.
actual_contract_review.finding: No actionable omitted hypothesis, target/source-direction error, false roundtrip premise or covering-surjectivity inference found in the bounded final-source read.

actual_controls.positive: The final positive module supplies actual Quiver Bool with Bool arrow values for every endpoint pair. outward false and outward true are two actual false->true paths with identical vertex lists but distinct full traces. The returning true->false path makes a valid length2 round trip. Actual encode/decode roundtrips, endpoint=false, nil-root preservation, wrong-root rejection and broken-join rejection are consumed.
actual_controls.negative: The actual full trace is [firstEdge:false->true, brokenEdge:false->false]. valid_initial proves ValidFrom false [firstEdge] only. The failing call decode false [firstEdge,brokenEdge] valid_initial requires the missing full-list validity and is the intended Application type mismatch.

pinned_api_reuse.excluded_api: Prefunctor.pathStar_surjective needs outgoing-star surjectivity; tagging into a SingleObj with labels from every possible source does not satisfy it. No full covering claim is made.

selected.title: Quiver Algebras, Path Coalgebras and co-reflexivity
selected.location: Section1, end of PDF page2 and start of page3
selected.correspondence: The primary definition keeps distinct arrows, demands consecutive target/source matches, treats each vertex as its own length-zero path, and concatenates only at a matching endpoint. This supports the tagged-edge, valid-join and explicit-empty-root conventions.
selected.limits: The local actual equivalence and decoder are not stated to be theorem ports from the paper. No path coalgebra, algebraic reconstruction, finite-dual or bialgebra conclusion is imported.
selected.license: The abstract-page license link resolves to arxiv nonexclusive-distrib/1.0. This is article distribution metadata, not an Apache/CC source-code license; only concise attribution/paraphrase is used.

fresh_official_anthropic_scout.exact_source_role: The reread actual PathsAndWalks source uses EndStatement.Path for w:Fin n->Fin n->Option Int and shows correspondence with vertex-list walks with finite WithTop weight. Its source graph stores one optional weight per ordered vertex pair.
fresh_official_anthropic_scout.limits: The correspondence preserves endpoints and total weights, not arbitrary parallel-arrow/path identity. It cannot supply the general TotalEdge equivalence or remove ValidFrom. No code is ported from this file; no source-language/refinement theorem is inferred.
fresh_official_anthropic_scout.rights: Original Anthropic,PBC2026 Apache-2.0/SPDX header retained in raw snapshot. Upstream native replay NOT_RUN.
